cache_key_derivation.quote:
def derive_cache_key(
    name: str,
    version: str,
    spec_version: str,
    files: dict[str, bytes],
) -> str:
    """TST-0080 cache-key derivation (quoted at this def).

    key = sha256( canonical_json({
        alg, name, version, spec_version,
        shipped_files: [{path, sha256, bytes}, ...]  # ALL shipped files, sorted
    }) )

    Name+version alone is not sufficient: a same-version republish must miss.
    Omitting any shipped file from shipped_files is a defect.
    """
    envelope = cache_key_envelope(name, version, spec_version, files)
    blob = canonical_json(envelope).encode("utf-8")
    return sha256_bytes(blob)

legacy_root.claim_under_test: A content-addressed cache key that includes every shipped file cannot serve a stale same-version package: installing a broken build, publishing a fix at the same version, and reinstalling observes the fixed behaviour. A hash that omits a shipped file is a defect because two different packages then share one key.

detector_control.expected_defect: two packages that differ only in pkg/extra.dat share one key when that path is omitted from the content hash; a name+version client keeps serving BROKEN after a same-version fix
